name: omi-provider
description: Pi-mono extension that optionally registers Omi as an LLM provider, enforces a dangerous-command denylist, and exposes local Omi tools.

scripts.test: if [ -e node_modules ]; then node --experimental-strip-types --test index.test.ts; elif [ -d ../agent/node_modules ]; then ln -s ../agent/node_modules node_modules; trap 'rm -f node_modules' EXIT; node --experimental-strip-types --test index.test.ts; else echo 'Missing dependencies: run npm install in ../agent first.' >&2; exit 1; fi
